title: Fields in practitioner_account_screening.csv
description: Screening log for candidate sources and account dispositions in the public AI-assisted Lean survey.

columns.candidate_id: Stable identifier for the screened source/candidate.
columns.author: Named source author(s).
columns.title: Source title or public description.
columns.citation_key: BibTeX key when included, supplemental, structured-study, or related-work evidence; may be blank for holds/exclusions.
columns.decision: include_account, supplemental_source, structured_study, related_work, hold, duplicate, or exclude.
columns.account_id: Account represented or supported when the screened source is stored in the normalized account/source tables; blank for external structured studies and related-work-only evidence.
columns.duplicate_of: candidate_id already representing the same source evidence; used only for true duplicate records.
